component.name: minio
component.title: Minio
component.description: Store and retrieve objects in MinIO or another Amazon S3 compatible object storage.
component.label: cloud,file

autoCreateBucket.label: common
autoCreateBucket.description: Whether to create the bucket at startup if it does not exist (skipped when objectName is set), and, for a consumer with moveAfterRead, the destinationBucketName bucket. If false, a missing destination bucket fails the start of the consumer.

configuration.description: The configuration that the endpoints of this component start from. The options set on an endpoint replace its values.

endpoint.label: common
endpoint.description: The MinIO server, or other Amazon S3 compatible service, to connect to: a URL such as http://localhost:9000, or a host name or IP address, for which the client uses HTTPS on port 443. Required unless minioClient is set.

minioClient.label: common
minioClient.description: To use a custom io.minio.MinioClient. When this option is set or autowired, the endpoint, proxyPort, secure, region, accessKey, secretKey and customHttpClient options are not used.

objectLock.label: common
objectLock.description: Whether to enable object locking on the buckets that the component creates (see autoCreateBucket). It does not change an existing bucket.

policy.label: common
policy.description: The bucket policy, as JSON, that the endpoint sets on the bucket at startup. Not applied when objectName is set.

proxyPort.label: common
proxyPort.description: The TCP port of the server. When set, it replaces the port of the endpoint option, and the secure option sets the scheme. Not used when minioClient is set.

region.label: common
region.description: The region of the server, for example us-east-1. The client signs its requests for this region, and the component creates buckets in it. If not set, the client asks the server for the region of the bucket.

secure.label: common
secure.description: Whether the client uses HTTPS (true) or HTTP (false) when proxyPort is set. Without proxyPort, this option is not used and the scheme of the endpoint option applies.

autoCloseBody.label: consumer
autoCloseBody.description: Whether the consumer closes the stream that it read the content of the object from, when the exchange is done. Only used when includeBody is true. If false, the consumer does not close the stream.

bridgeErrorHandler.label: consumer
bridgeErrorHandler.description: Allows for bridging the consumer to the Camel routing Error Handler, which mean any exceptions (if possible) occurred while the Camel consumer is trying to pickup incoming messages, or the likes, will now be processed as a message and handled by the routing Error Handler. Important: This is only possible if the 3rd party component allows Camel to be alerted if an exception was thrown. Some components handle this internally only, and therefore bridgeErrorHandler is not possible. In other situations we may improve the Camel component to hook into the 3rd party component and make this possible for future releases. By default the consumer will use the org.apache.camel.spi.ExceptionHandler to deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

bypassGovernanceMode.label: consumer
bypassGovernanceMode.description: Whether the consumer bypasses the governance mode retention of object locking when it deletes an object with deleteAfterRead or moveAfterRead. This needs the s3:BypassGovernanceRetention permission.

deleteAfterRead.label: consumer
deleteAfterRead.description: Whether the consumer deletes the object from the bucket after the exchange completes successfully. If false, the consumer gets the same objects again in later polls: use the Idempotent Consumer EIP to filter out duplicates, for example by the CamelMinioObjectName header.

delimiter.label: consumer
delimiter.description: The delimiter that the listing requests of the consumer use to group object names into folders. If not set, the listing uses /. Not used when recursive is true.

destinationBucketName.label: consumer
destinationBucketName.description: The bucket that the consumer moves the consumed objects to, with moveAfterRead, which requires it. The producer reads the bucket of copyObject from the CamelMinioDestinationBucketName header instead.

destinationObjectName.label: consumer
destinationObjectName.description: The object name that the consumer moves the consumed objects to, in destinationBucketName, with moveAfterRead. If not set, the name of the consumed object. With a fixed name, each moved object replaces the previous one.

includeBody.label: consumer
includeBody.description: Whether the consumer reads the content of the object into the body, as a byte array. If false, the body is null and the headers carry the metadata of the object.

includeFolders.label: consumer
includeFolders.description: Whether the consumer also creates an exchange for the folder entries of the listing. By default, it skips them.

includeUserMetadata.label: consumer
includeUserMetadata.description: Whether the listing requests of the consumer ask for the user metadata of the objects (a MinIO extension of ListObjectsV2). The consumer does not set this metadata on the message. The listing fails if useVersion1 or includeVersions is also true.

includeVersions.label: consumer
includeVersions.description: Whether the consumer lists all versions of the objects. It still gets each listed object name once per poll, in the version that the versionId option selects, else the current version.

length.label: consumer
length.description: The number of bytes of the object, from offset, that the consumer gets. With moveAfterRead, the consumer copies only these bytes. The default 0 means up to the end of the object.

matchETag.label: consumer
matchETag.description: The consumer gets an object only if its ETag matches this value (the If-Match condition). For an object that does not match, the request fails and the consumer reports an error.

maxConnections.label: consumer
maxConnections.description: Not used: the component does not pass this value to the MinIO client. Configure the connection pool of the OkHttpClient of the customHttpClient option instead.

maxMessagesPerPoll.label: consumer
maxMessagesPerPoll.description: The maximum number of objects that the consumer lists and consumes in one poll, which is also the page size of its listing requests. Use 0 or a negative number for no limit. Not used when objectName is set.

modifiedSince.label: consumer
modifiedSince.description: The consumer gets an object only if it was modified after this time (the If-Modified-Since condition). For another object, the request fails and the consumer reports an error.

moveAfterRead.label: consumer
moveAfterRead.description: Whether the consumer copies the object to destinationBucketName after the exchange completes successfully, and then deletes it from the bucket, also when deleteAfterRead is false.

notMatchETag.label: consumer
notMatchETag.description: The consumer gets an object only if its ETag does not match this value (the If-None-Match condition). For an object that matches, the request fails and the consumer reports an error.

objectName.label: consumer
objectName.description: The name of the one object that the consumer gets in each poll, instead of listing the bucket. When set, the endpoint does not check or create the bucket, and does not set the policy, at startup.

offset.label: consumer
offset.description: The position of the first byte of the object that the consumer gets. With moveAfterRead, the consumer copies only the bytes from this position. The default 0 is the start of the object.

prefix.label: consumer
prefix.description: The prefix of the names of the objects that the consumer lists.

recursive.label: consumer
recursive.description: Whether the consumer lists all the objects below the prefix. If false, the listing stops at the delimiter and returns the folders as entries, which the consumer skips unless includeFolders is true.

startAfter.label: consumer
startAfter.description: The object name after which the consumer lists the bucket, at the start of each pass through the bucket. The listing returns only the names that sort after it.

unModifiedSince.label: consumer
unModifiedSince.description: The consumer gets an object only if it was not modified after this time (the If-Unmodified-Since condition). For another object, the request fails and the consumer reports an error.

useVersion1.label: consumer
useVersion1.description: Whether the consumer lists the bucket with version 1 of the ListObjects API instead of ListObjectsV2.

versionId.label: consumer
versionId.description: The version of the objects that the consumer gets, deletes with deleteAfterRead and copies with moveAfterRead. If not set, the current version.

deleteAfterWrite.label: producer
deleteAfterWrite.description: Whether the producer deletes the file after it uploaded it, when the body is a java.io.File, for example the file of a file consumer. Other bodies are not affected.

keyName.label: producer
keyName.description: The name of the object that the producer uploads, gets, deletes, copies (the source of copyObject) or creates a link for. The CamelMinioObjectName header replaces it.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

operation.label: producer
operation.description: The operation that the producer performs. If not set, the producer uploads the body as an object. The CamelMinioOperation header replaces it.

pojoRequest.label: producer
pojoRequest.description: Whether the body is the builder of the request of the MinIO Java SDK, such as io.minio.GetObjectArgs.Builder for getObject, instead of the producer building the request from options and headers. deleteObjects works only with true, and listBuckets does not use it.

storageClass.label: producer
storageClass.description: The storage class of the objects that the producer uploads, sent as the x-amz-storage-class header, for example STANDARD or REDUCED_REDUNDANCY. The CamelMinioStorageClass header replaces it.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

customHttpClient.label: advanced
customHttpClient.description: To use a custom okhttp3.OkHttpClient for the requests to the server, for example to configure timeouts, a proxy or the connection pool. Not used when minioClient is set.

healthCheckConsumerEnabled.label: health
healthCheckConsumerEnabled.description: Used for enabling or disabling all consumer based health checks from this component

healthCheckProducerEnabled.label: health
healthCheckProducerEnabled.description: Used for enabling or disabling all producer based health checks from this component. Notice: Camel has by default disabled all producer based health-checks. You can turn on producer checks globally by setting camel.health.producersEnabled=true.

accessKey.label: security
accessKey.description: The access key (user name) for the requests to the server. If accessKey or secretKey is not set, the client sends the requests without credentials. Not used when minioClient is set.

secretKey.label: security
secretKey.description: The secret key (password) of the accessKey. If accessKey or secretKey is not set, the client sends the requests without credentials. Not used when minioClient is set.

serverSideEncryption.label: security
serverSideEncryption.description: The server-side encryption, as an io.minio.ServerSideEncryption such as ServerSideEncryption.S3 or ServerSideEncryption.KMS, of the objects that the producer uploads or copies with copyObject, and that the consumer copies with moveAfterRead. The producer fails to start if serverSideEncryptionCustomerKey is also set.

serverSideEncryptionCustomerKey.label: security
serverSideEncryptionCustomerKey.description: The key for server-side encryption with a customer-provided key (SSE-C), as an io.minio.ServerSideEncryption.CustomerKey. The consumer uses it to get the objects and to copy them with moveAfterRead; the producer to get, upload and copy objects. The producer fails to start if serverSideEncryption is also set.

CamelMinioBucketName.description: The name of the bucket of the consumed object. The consumer sets it. The producer does not read it: the CamelMinioOverrideBucketName header sets the bucket of the producer.

CamelMinioDestinationBucketName.label: producer
CamelMinioDestinationBucketName.description: The bucket that the producer copies the object to, for copyObject, which requires it.

CamelMinioContentControl.description: The Cache-Control of the object. The consumer sets it from the consumed object. The producer stores it as user metadata (x-amz-meta-Cache-Control) of the object it uploads.

CamelMinioContentDisposition.description: The Content-Disposition of the object. The consumer sets it from the consumed object. The producer stores it as user metadata (x-amz-meta-Content-Disposition) of the object it uploads.

CamelMinioContentEncoding.description: The Content-Encoding of the object. The consumer sets it from the consumed object. The producer stores it as user metadata (x-amz-meta-Content-Encoding) of the object it uploads.

CamelMinioContentLength.description: The size of the object in bytes. The consumer sets it for the consumed object. The producer uses it as the length of a body whose length it cannot tell without reading it.

CamelMinioContentMD5.description: The Content-MD5 of the object that the producer uploads, the Base64 encoded MD5 digest of its content. The producer stores it as user metadata (x-amz-meta-Content-Md5) of the object.

CamelMinioContentType.description: The Content-Type of the object. The consumer sets it from the consumed object. The producer stores it as user metadata (x-amz-meta-Content-Type) of the object it uploads.

CamelMinioETag.description: The entity tag (ETag) of the object. The consumer sets it for the consumed object, and the producer for the object it uploaded.

CamelMinioObjectName.description: The name of the object. The consumer sets it for the consumed object. The producer reads it as the object to upload, get, delete, copy or create a link for, and it replaces the keyName option.

CamelMinioDestinationObjectName.label: producer
CamelMinioDestinationObjectName.description: The name of the object that the producer copies to, for copyObject, which requires it.

CamelMinioLastModified.description: The value of the Last-Modified HTTP header of the consumed object. The consumer sets it.

CamelMinioStorageClass.label: producer
CamelMinioStorageClass.description: The storage class of the object. The consumer sets it from the consumed object when the server returns one. The producer reads it as the storage class of the object it uploads, and it replaces the storageClass option.

CamelMinioVersionId.description: The version ID of the object, when versioning is enabled on the bucket. The consumer sets it for the consumed object, and the producer for the object it uploaded or copied with copyObject.

CamelMinioCannedAcl.label: producer
CamelMinioCannedAcl.description: The canned ACL of the object that the producer uploads, sent as the x-amz-acl header, for example private or public-read.

CamelMinioOperation.label: producer
CamelMinioOperation.description: The operation that the producer performs. It replaces the operation option.

CamelMinioServerSideEncryption.description: The server-side encryption algorithm of the consumed object, from the x-amz-server-side-encryption header, for example AES256. The consumer sets it. The producer does not read it: the serverSideEncryption option sets the encryption of uploads.

CamelMinioExpirationTime.description: The value of the x-amz-expiration header of the consumed object: when a lifecycle rule of the bucket expires the object. The consumer sets it.

CamelMinioReplicationStatus.description: The replication status of the consumed object, from the x-amz-replication-status header. The consumer sets it.

CamelMinioOffset.label: producer
CamelMinioOffset.description: The position of the first byte that the producer gets, for getObjectRange, which requires it.

CamelMinioLength.label: producer
CamelMinioLength.description: The number of bytes, from CamelMinioOffset, that the producer gets, for getObjectRange, which requires it.

CamelMinioPresignedURLExpirationTime.label: producer
CamelMinioPresignedURLExpirationTime.description: How long, in seconds, the URL of createDownloadLink and createUploadLink is valid: from 1 to 604800 (7 days). The default is 3600 (one hour).

CamelMinioOverrideBucketName.description: The name of the bucket for the producer. It replaces the bucket of the endpoint.

consumerOut.description: The content of the object as a byte array, one message per object, with its metadata in headers. No body with includeBody=false

producerIn.description: The content to upload, when no operation is set: text, bytes, a stream or a file. A Map, a List or no body fails: marshal it first. The operations take their input from headers, or with pojoRequest=true from the builder of the request of the Minio SDK in the body, such as a GetObjectArgs.Builder; deleteObjects works only so

producerOut.description: Unchanged after an upload and a copyObject, with the ETag in a header. By the operation: the stream of the object for getObject and getObjectRange, a lazy Iterable of Result for listObjects, whose get() gives the Item, an Iterator of Bucket for listBuckets, true for the deletes, ok for deleteBucket and the URL as text for the links

bucketName.description: The name of the bucket. Unless objectName is set, the endpoint checks at startup that the bucket exists, and creates it if autoCreateBucket is true. The CamelMinioOverrideBucketName header replaces it for the producer.

sendEmptyMessageWhenIdle.description: If the polling consumer did not poll any files, you can enable this option to send an empty message (no body) instead.

exceptionHandler.label: consumer,advanced
exceptionHandler.description: To let the consumer use a custom ExceptionHandler. Notice if the option bridgeErrorHandler is enabled then this option is not in use. By default the consumer will deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

exchangePattern.label: consumer,advanced
exchangePattern.description: Sets the exchange pattern when the consumer creates an exchange.

pollStrategy.label: consumer,advanced
pollStrategy.description: A pluggable org.apache.camel.PollingConsumerPollingStrategy allowing you to provide your custom implementation to control error handling usually occurred during the poll operation before an Exchange have been created and being routed in Camel.

deleteAfterWrite.label: producer
deleteAfterWrite.description: Whether the producer deletes the file after it uploaded it, when the body is a java.io.File, for example the file of a file consumer. Other bodies are not affected.

keyName.label: producer
keyName.description: The name of the object that the producer uploads, gets, deletes, copies (the source of copyObject) or creates a link for. The CamelMinioObjectName header replaces it.

operation.label: producer
operation.description: The operation that the producer performs. If not set, the producer uploads the body as an object. The CamelMinioOperation header replaces it.

pojoRequest.label: producer
pojoRequest.description: Whether the body is the builder of the request of the MinIO Java SDK, such as io.minio.GetObjectArgs.Builder for getObject, instead of the producer building the request from options and headers. deleteObjects works only with true, and listBuckets does not use it.

backoffErrorThreshold.label: consumer,scheduler
backoffErrorThreshold.description: The number of subsequent error polls (failed due some error) that should happen before the backoffMultipler should kick-in.

backoffIdleThreshold.label: consumer,scheduler
backoffIdleThreshold.description: The number of subsequent idle polls that should happen before the backoffMultipler should kick-in.

backoffMultiplier.label: consumer,scheduler
backoffMultiplier.description: To let the scheduled polling consumer backoff if there has been a number of subsequent idles/errors in a row. The multiplier is then the number of polls that will be skipped before the next actual attempt is happening again. When this option is in use then backoffIdleThreshold and/or backoffErrorThreshold must also be configured.

greedy.label: consumer,scheduler
greedy.description: If greedy is enabled, then the ScheduledPollConsumer will run immediately again, if the previous run polled 1 or more messages.

healthCheckMaxPollDuration.label: consumer,scheduler
healthCheckMaxPollDuration.description: How long a poll may run before the health check of the consumer reports DOWN. The health check is otherwise based on the polls that are done, so it stays UP while a poll hangs, for example on a read without timeout from a connection that went silent. A poll includes routing the messages it polled, so set this above the longest poll you expect. The poll is not interrupted. The value is in millis (not affected by timeUnit). The default 0 turns this off.

initialDelay.label: consumer,scheduler
initialDelay.description: Milliseconds before the first poll starts.

repeatCount.label: consumer,scheduler
repeatCount.description: Specifies a maximum limit of number of fires. So if you set it to 1, the scheduler will only fire once. If you set it to 5, it will only fire five times. A value of zero or negative means fire forever.

runLoggingLevel.label: consumer,scheduler
runLoggingLevel.description: The consumer logs a start/complete log line when it polls. This option allows you to configure the logging level for that.

scheduledExecutorService.label: consumer,scheduler
scheduledExecutorService.description: Allows for configuring a custom/shared thread pool to use for the consumer. By default each consumer has its own single threaded thread pool.

scheduler.label: consumer,scheduler
scheduler.description: To use a cron scheduler from either camel-spring or camel-quartz component. Use value spring or quartz for built in scheduler

schedulerProperties.label: consumer,scheduler
schedulerProperties.description: To configure additional properties when using a custom scheduler or any of the Quartz, Spring based scheduler. This is a multi-value option with prefix: scheduler.

startScheduler.label: consumer,scheduler
startScheduler.description: Whether the scheduler should be auto started.

timeUnit.label: consumer,scheduler
timeUnit.description: Time unit for initialDelay and delay options.

useFixedDelay.label: consumer,scheduler
useFixedDelay.description: Controls if fixed delay or fixed rate is used. See ScheduledExecutorService in JDK for details.

accessKey.label: security
accessKey.description: The access key (user name) for the requests to the server. If accessKey or secretKey is not set, the client sends the requests without credentials. Not used when minioClient is set.

secretKey.label: security
secretKey.description: The secret key (password) of the accessKey. If accessKey or secretKey is not set, the client sends the requests without credentials. Not used when minioClient is set.
